CREATE TABLE raw_ingest (
    ingested_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    source text NOT NULL,
    payload jsonb NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX idx_raw_ingest_source ON raw_ingest(source);

CREATE TABLE ingest_watermark (
    source text PRIMARY KEY,
    max_event_ts timestamptz
);

CREATE TABLE machines (
    id text PRIMARY KEY,
    process_time_s double precision,
    availability double precision,
    mttr_s double precision,
    work_power_kw double precision,
    idle_power_kw double precision
);

INSERT INTO machines (id, process_time_s, availability, mttr_s, work_power_kw, idle_power_kw) VALUES
('M1', 60.0, 0.995, 300.0, 3.0, 0.3),
('M2', 80.0, 0.99, 600.0, 5.0, 0.5),
('M3', 70.0, 0.99, 600.0, 4.5, 0.45),
('M4', 75.0, 0.995, 300.0, 4.0, 0.4);

CREATE TABLE buffers (
    id text PRIMARY KEY,
    capacity int,
    before text,
    after text
);

INSERT INTO buffers (id, capacity, before, after) VALUES
('B0', 25, 'source', 'M1'),
('B1', 10, 'M1', 'M2'),
('B2', 10, 'M2', 'M3'),
('B3', 10, 'M3', 'M4');

CREATE TABLE tag_map (
    tag_id text PRIMARY KEY,
    machine_id text,
    signal text,
    unit text,
    register text,
    scale double precision
);

INSERT INTO tag_map (tag_id, machine_id, signal, unit, register, scale) VALUES
('Avg_Time_per_part_s', 'M1', 'Avg_Time_per_part_s', 's', 'Avg_Time_per_part_s', 1.0),
('Availability_%', 'M1', 'Availability_%', '%', 'Availability_%', 1.0),
('MTTR_s', 'M1', 'MTTR_s', 's', 'MTTR_s', 1.0),
('EnergyIdling', 'M1', 'EnergyIdling', 'kWh', 'EnergyIdling', 1.0),
('EnergyWorking', 'M1', 'EnergyWorking', 'kWh', 'EnergyWorking', 1.0);

CREATE TABLE events (
    ts timestamptz NOT NULL,
    machine_id text NOT NULL,
    reason_code text,
    duration_s double precision,
    energy_kwh double precision
);

CREATE INDEX idx_events_machine_id_ts ON events(machine_id, ts);

CREATE TABLE samples (
    ts timestamptz NOT NULL,
    machine_id text NOT NULL,
    tag text NOT NULL,
    value double precision
);

CREATE INDEX idx_samples_machine_id_ts ON samples(machine_id, ts);

CREATE VIEW v_raw_events AS
SELECT
    T1.ts,
    T1.machine_id,
    T1.reason_code,
    T1.duration_s,
    T1.energy_kwh
FROM events AS T1;

CREATE VIEW v_raw_samples AS
SELECT
    T1.ts,
    T1.machine_id,
    T1.tag,
    T1.value
FROM samples AS T1;
